|cffffcc00Weapons|r: Are in the form of items. You start of with a |cff33BBBBBasic Cannon|r. Get new ones by purchasing them in various shops.

|cffffcc00Change Ship|r: Can be done easy. Just buy a new one in your |cff33BBBBMain Harbour|r.

|cffffcc00To Win|r: Destroy the enemy |cff33BBBBMain Harbour|r. It's that "easy".

|cffFF6666Commands Available|r

|cffffcc00-kick|r - Shows you the |cff33BBBBKick Menu|r. Only available once in a minute.

|cffffcc00-golddump on|r - Gives your gold to the computer player to evenly distribute to your team.  Very useful for traders.

|cffffcc00-golddump off|r - Turns off the '-golddump on' command, and stops your gold from being given to the computer player.

|cffffcc00-spawns on|r - Turns off the '-spawns off' command, and allows your harbors to generate empire ships once more.  ( this ability can only be used if your opponent's side harbors are destroyed )

|cffffcc00-spawns off|r - Turns off the '-spawns on' command, and stops your Empire harbors from generating ships to attack the enemy.  ( this ability can only be used if your opponent's side harbors are destroyed )

2766:
|cffffcc00Step 1|r: Get a |cff33BBBBTrade Boat|r. You need it to do any sort of trading.

|cffffcc00Step 2|r: Get a |cff33BBBBTrading Contract|r. Get it from your local |cff33BBBBTrade Master|r.

|cffffcc00Step 3|r: Finally, follow the instructions on your |cff33BBBBTrading Contract|r and return to your |cff33BBBBTrade Master|r for the reward.

|cffffcc00Tips|r:
- The more you trade, the more experience in trading you will recieve. The trading experience is counted to your |cff66FF66Lumber|r. The more |cff66FF66Lumber|r you got, the better and more profitable quests you can use.
- Try to get your teammates to protect you, and get them to kill the enemy traders.

-added support for '-golddump on/off commands' (see general help)

-added a new boat (the Goblin Ship)
-fixed a variety of bugs.
-added a whole new array of trading with the Refinery.
-added new icons to the map.
-fixed a major trading exploit where the trader built a missle silo close to the main harbor and was able to change ships (moving him back to base) from anywhere in the map.
-fixed gold distribution for kicked players
-fixed casting times for shore leave and get onboard
